patient-explanation:
During your lunch on April 7, 2025 you ate 15 g of butter and 20 g of durum‑wheat bread.  The health‑monitoring rules for you say:
• Butter must be **less than 10 g per meal**.
• Durum‑wheat bread must be **completely avoided** (0 g) at every meal.
Because you ate more butter than allowed (15 g > 10 g) and you also ate bread that you must not eat at all (20 g > 0 g), two rule breaches occurred.  These are recorded as two separate violations for this lunch.
